title: Implement credential filtering/scrubbing in JSON export
description: Implement filtering logic to ensure any credential data is scrubbed from the JSON export, even if present in the application state.
acceptanceCriteria: Credential filtering is applied during JSON serialization
No credential fields leak into exported JSON
Filter is applied consistently across all export paths
